dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me a bit about kuuvahki...

dialogues.speaker: Lyulka
dialogues.text: Kuuvahki is like... Gah, it's hard to explain, so just think of it as a sort of powerful energy. That's how all the machines here are powered.

dialogues.speaker: Lyulka
dialogues.text: The Frostmoon Scions call this a blessing or whatever... Just listen and nod when they do.
